# State machines (Foundations §08)

## Capture FSM

`UNPAIRED` → `PAIRED` → `IDLE` → `CONSENT_VERIFIED` → `CAPTURING` → `PAUSED` → `STOPPED` → `SYNCING` → `PROCESSING` → `DRAFT_READY` → `REVIEWED` → `SIGNED` → `EMR_PENDING` → `EMR_CONFIRMED` → `CONSENT_REVOKED` → `PATIENT_CHANGED` → `TRANSFER_INTERRUPTED`

Where: W-01 → A-02 → A-03 → A-06 → A-04 → A-05 → H-04; exceptions in A-09 and A-06b.

## Care task lifecycle

`PROPOSED` → `PHYSICIAN_APPROVED` → `ASSIGNED` → `AWAITING_REPORT` → `REPORT_RECEIVED` → `AWAITING_REVIEW` → `REVIEWED` → `CONTACT_PENDING` → `PATIENT_CONTACTED` → `FOLLOWUP_BOOKED` → `CLOSED` → `BLOCKED` → `OVERDUE` → `CANCELLED` → `UNREACHABLE`

Where: E-05 → C-01 → C-02 → C-03 → C-04. Sent reminder never closes a task.

## Failure modes the UI must show

`No consent` → `Clip disconnected` → `Low audio` → `Uncertain speaker` → `Wrong patient` → `AI outage` → `Record conflict` → `Late result` → `Emergency symptom`

Where: E-04 · W-02 · A-06d · A-10 · A-09 · A-06c · H-04 / E-07 · C-04 · A-08.
